entrypoint: run_probe(database, existing_empty_directory, expected_origin=explicit_https_origin, idle_seconds=35, max_requests=160, max_seconds=300)
invocation_requirements: Run in a dedicated Python process from a clean exact8f normal clone with existing prepared pinned runtime and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; set PYTHONPATH to its casepath-api directory.

Privately construct TursoDatabase(private_libsql_url, private_token, reuse_http=True) with the unmodified default client; no client_factory. Do not call create_hosted_app, HostedJournal, WorkStore or lease initialization.
Pass an existing empty scoped directory and the explicit canonical HTTPS database origin (no path/trailing slash). No credential arguments on command line, logs or receipts.

Import this probe by importlib.util.spec_from_file_location; call run_probe once; save only its returned redacted dictionary outside the empty directory; finally close the caller-owned database. Stop if all_ok is false; no automatic retry.

Use the existing prepared Mac runtime; no dependency installation required. httpx0.28.1/httpcore1.0.9/FastAPI0.116.1/Starlette0.47.3 from current repository pins. Actual dependency versions are recorded.
measurement_limits: HTTPX connect_tcp includes DNS; absent trace events do not prove socket reuse.
Headers/body plus native trace events; no Sites/client network path is measured.
Probe-owned locks measure isolated acquisition overhead, not contention or dispatch inside the deployed ASGI instance.
Method timings are inclusive and overlap; residual is not a pure CPU/network subtraction.
Encoding uses current no-response-model jsonable_encoder/JSONResponse primitives, not a whole HTTP request.
Cloud checks use MockTransport only and different FastAPI/Starlette versions; no native performance acceptance claim.

latest_owner_reported_lead.qualification: Mac owner reports; not independently requested from Cloud; no instance or transport cause inferred.
